subject: Re: ACME - Portal evidence provenance & owner matrix
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <security@acme-payments.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: audit_team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial portal onboarding + evidence provenance mapping

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. As we kick off the portal migration I wanted to capture two things we need for our SOC2 pre-check: a clear owner matrix that maps portal sections (Whistic / OneTrust / Vendr) to Redwood owners, and an evidence provenance manifest that ties each CAIQ answer to an S3 object or document (and who provided/validated it).

Can you: 1) drop an ownership matrix (simple spreadsheet is fine) with names and backup contacts, 2) provide a manifest of where current evidence lives (S3 prefixes, Drive links), and 3) confirm whether you rotate the ephemeral credentials used by the ingestion tooling and how that rotation is audited?

We're targeting an internal freeze window November 10-12 ahead of our auditor's discovery on Nov 16. If we can lock owners and provenance mapping before the freeze, that makes the audit run smoother.

Appreciate it — Marta

--
Marta Ruiz
Head of Security Operations | Acme Payments
security@acme-payments.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@acme-payments.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial portal onboarding + evidence provenance mapping

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask.

Quick plan:
- Attached is an ownership_matrix_v1.xlsx mapping Whistic/OneTrust/Vendr sections to primary + secondary owners. Primary owners will be accountable during your freeze window; secondaries are on-call for handoffs.
- Ben is attaching an S3 manifest with current evidence prefixes and keys; we'll also include Drive links for any docs we don't keep in S3.
- Aditya will summarize credential rotation and ingestion audit logs; short answer — ephemeral keys rotate every 24 hours and we record key usage in centralized audit logs forwarded to our SIEM.

We'll also create a small CAIQ patch (csv) that maps question IDs to evidence object IDs — see caiaq_patch.csv once Ben uploads it. If you want, we can run a quick reconciliation event with your team before Nov 8.

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial portal onboarding + evidence provenance mapping

Thanks — attaching s3_evidence_manifest.json and caiaq_patch.csv for initial ingestion. Notes: 
- Manifest entries use the pattern s3://redwood-evidence/<account>/<portal>/<document-id>. We included a "provenance" field with uploader and timestamp.
- A few legacy artifacts live in a shared Drive (links included in the manifest).
- Ephemeral credentials: ingestion lambda assumes a short-lived STS role. Rotation is triggered by our key-rotation pipeline; the rotation event writes an HMAC-signed rotation record to audit-logs (we can push a copy to your S3 bucket if helpful).

Caveats: We have three CAIQ QIDs that currently reference aggregated evidence ("syslogs rolled-up") rather than discrete objects. If the auditor requires raw artifacts for those, we'll need a short extraction task and one-time upload to an evidence prefix. Schedule wise that extraction takes ~1 business day.

Attachments: s3_evidence_manifest.json, caiaq_patch.csv

- Ben

--
Ben Carter
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: 2026-11-03T10:04:00-07:00

Adding a couple of operational details from the ingestion/automation side: 
- We support direct OneTrust and Whistic API ingestion; for Vendr we currently rely on a CSV export ingest. We plan a weekly reconciliation job that applies the caiaq_patch.csv mappings to the portal entries and flags mismatches in a reconciliation report.
- Access requests for portal service accounts: please share a short list of technical contacts from your side who need read-only access to Whistic/OneTrust. We will provision IAM roles scoped to read-only and bind to short-lived Okta sessions.
- HubSpot ref: I've added the HubSpot deal link for account context: https://hubspot.company/deal/ACME-4521 (internal).

If the freeze window (Nov 10-12) is still good, we should aim to complete reconciliation and owner sign-offs by EOD Nov 8 so we can lock the evidence prefixes.

Perfect — this is exactly what we needed. A few follow-ups: 
1) We'll send a short list of read-only contacts by EOB tomorrow for portal access.
2) Please upload the HMAC-signed rotation records (audit logs) to our temporary S3 prefix: s3://acme-temp/redwood-rotation/ so our audit tooling can index them before Nov 12.
3) For the three CAIQ items referencing aggregated syslogs, please start the extraction task and notify us when ready; we'll treat the resulting artifacts as "special evidence" and they can live under the shared Drive if needed.

We'll plan a 30-minute reconciliation call Nov 6 (I'll propose a few times). Once owners sign off on Nov 8 we'll mark the prefixes read-only for the freeze.

Thanks again — Marta

--
